name: jobhunter
description: AI Job Hunter — autonomous job-search agent with a control dashboard

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @jobhunter/server" "npm run dev -w @jobhunter/web"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @jobhunter/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/db && tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web
